data.narrative:
Skild AI is a Series C artificial intelligence and software company founded by Deepak Pathak and Abhinav Gupta, currently valued at $14.0B post-money following $1.4B+ in total capital raised. The peer universe comprises 9 comparable companies—1 public (Palantir) and 8 private firms including Figure AI, Scale AI, Crusoe Energy, Wayve, and Waymo—all operating in the AI & Software sector at Series B through Series D stages.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using a 1.7x multiplier typical for Series C advancement, implies a forward valuation of $23.8B. Peer-median analysis across six same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $9.3B, with a observed range spanning $3.2B to $39.0B. The peer set reflects substantial dispersion, reflecting differing company maturity, capital intensity, and investor sentiment within the frontier AI sector.

Triangulating both methods produces a valuation range of $7.9B (low) to $27.4B (high), with a median of $16.6B. The current $14.0B valuation sits below the median estimate, suggesting modest upside to fair value under this framework. Key uncertainties include the appropriate step-up multiplier for Series C exits in a volatile AI market, and the representativeness of peer multiples given wide dispersion across the comparable set. The $9.6B spread between low and high estimates reflects material ambiguity in market benchmarks.
